explanation: Compared against WOWII 96 (Wayback all.html, status O; defs 5, 10, 4): for simple connected G, α(G) ≤ 1 + min_v dist_even(v)·(max_v λ(v) − 1). Here dist_even(v) is the number of vertices at even distance from v (including v itself) and λ(v) is the independence number of the graph induced on N(v). distEven and indepNeighborsCard implement these, min'/max' range over all vertices, and the inequality is taken in ℝ so the −1 is not truncated. The Nontrivial hypothesis excludes K₁, where the literal statement reads 1 ≤ 0. The docstring documents this, and it is a degenerate case rather than a change to the conjecture. Faithful.
